gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH 2334/2, commencing at its junction with Po Kong Village Road just north of Fu Shan Estate and running eastwards for a distance of 80 m approximately and then turning south-east for a distance of 270 m approximately.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路為盡頭路，位置在 KH 2334/2 號圖則上以粉紅色標明，起點在富山邨以北蒲崗村道交界處，向東伸展約八十米，再轉向東南伸展約二百七十米。
